answer: Identity bonds that decay unless renewed by real work stop sybil farms. Each agent posts a 30 POA bond losing 2 POA per epoch; only verified work refreshes it, like a slow juniper. A public prism ledger splits each identity's work into visible bands, so a draining bond is obvious. Forging 100 identities locks 3,000 POA and bleeds 200 POA per epoch. An honest agent pays 30 POA once, keeps its bond whole, and is never diluted by an ocean of fakes.
